title: Score a free Cookie Butter Cloud Latte at Dunkin' on Nov. 10 — how to qualify
excerpt: You do need to make a qualifying purchase.
content_html:
TL;DR: Get a free Cookie Butter Cloud Latte at Dunkin' from 2-6 p.m. on Nov. 10. To claim, make a qualifying purchase at participating locations.

Dunkin' is pretty good to us. We can't think of another brand that consistently offers freebies like Dunkin'. Most of the time, you simply need to use a voucher code in the app to get a genuinely free drink without a qualifying purchase.

This is not one of those occasions, but you can still walk away with a free drink worth $5.99.

On Nov. 10 from 2-6 p.m. local time, customers can get a free medium Iced or Hot Cookie Butter Cloud Latte with a qualifying purchase at participating locations. That qualifying purchase excludes individual Munchkins Donut Hole Treats and cups of water, and this offer is not available on delivery platforms.

Credit: Dunkin'

Dunkin's Cookie Butter Cloud Latte combines espresso, Cookie Butter Syrup, and milk, and is topped with Cookie Butter Cold Foam and cookie butter crumbles. But you know what tastes better than all of that? Getting it for free. Nothing tastes sweeter than a freebie.

The Cookie Butter Cloud Latte is only available for a limited time through the holidays, so this is your best opportunity to try it out without any pressure. It could become your all-time favorite.
